summary: ICICI Bank Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to furnish an investor presentation that will be referenced during its earnings call for the quarter and fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine foreign issuer report under Rule 13a-16, containing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. No deal terms, pricing, premiums, or structural mechanics are mentioned. This is purely an ancillary disclosure of earnings-related materials.
